provenance: Original v1 and v2 remain unchanged at6c214154. V2 axis anchors and eligibility rules are incorporated; this document specifies the previously unresolved analysis choices.
authority: This is a review proposal, not a new release requirement or permission to collect data/run models/providers. All numeric thresholds require adoption before candidate output ratings are unblinded.

raterAggregation.axisScores: Each rater assigns integer0..4 independently for all four axes, plus reasoned hard-gate flags. Both phrase fields are scored as one output.
raterAggregation.agreementOrOnePointDifference: When the two axis ratings differ by0 or1, the final axis score is their arithmetic mean; half points are retained without rounding.
raterAggregation.largeDifference: When an axis differs by2 or more, a third independent blinded rater scores that axis without seeing prior scores; the final axis score is the median of all three. Adjudication does not erase or overwrite original ratings.
raterAggregation.hardGateDisagreement: A third blinded adjudicator reviews the exact canonical evidence and each rationale. A flag is resolved only with a retained evidence-based rationale and at least two agreeing judgments. Any unresolved concern is HOLD, never averaged into a pass. Resolved failures remain failures independently of numeric mean.
raterAggregation.finalOutputScore: Use the finalized axis scores in30*grounding/4 +35*actionability/4 +25*specificity/4 +10*clarity/4. Do not average totals produced under different adjudication rules.
raterAggregation.clusterScore: For each input/model average its three declared trial output scores only when all are eligible; pair candidate minus Gemini within the same trial, then average the three paired deltas. Any missing/invalid/unknown required cell prevents qualification; report conditional descriptive scores separately.

proposedQualificationPopulation.scope: Prospective qualification beyond the authorized six-input functional screen; no acquisition/execution authorized here.
proposedQualificationPopulation.clusterRule: A canonical source/speaker/task family must not be represented as independent clusters. Select one qualifying input per dependent family before freeze; otherwise revise clustering/design before unblinding. Synthetic cases do not establish generalization to speakers.
proposedQualificationPopulation.sufficiency: These counts are proposed entry floors, not a power guarantee. Qualification also requires interval precision and every hard/operational gate below. Six existing synthetic inputs are automatically INCONCLUSIVE for population/model-promotion claims.
proposedQualificationPopulation.budgetDisclosure: At180 inputs x3 trials, one Gemini arm alone would require540 fresh calls absent qualifying retained same-request outputs: at10 uncached/day this is at least54 days. This is a proposed design cost, not an expanded budget or a justification to delay MVP. A smaller feasible design must be reviewed/frozen before outputs; do not silently lower the count after results.
proposedQualificationPopulation.unresolvedAdoptionLimit: Deterministic sparse/substantive criteria and overlap precedence are NOT YET DEFINED/ADOPTED. The named strata are prospective labels only; do not assign or qualify a broader corpus until those rules are reviewed and frozen. Existing six inputs do not adopt a population taxonomy.

proposedPairedAnalysis.direction: Delta=candidate score minus Gemini score; larger is better.
proposedPairedAnalysis.aggregation: Equal weight to each of the six strata; equal input-cluster weight within stratum; all three repeats travel with their cluster. Report each stratum and overall result separately.
proposedPairedAnalysis.intervalMethod: Stratified paired nonparametric cluster percentile bootstrap:100000 replicates, resample N input-cluster deltas with replacement within each stratum, preserve all within-cluster trial pairing, calculate each stratum mean and the equal-stratum overall mean.
proposedPairedAnalysis.reproducibility: Fixed nonzero xorshift32 seed20261022; unsigned32-bit x^=x<<13, x^=x>>>17, x^=x<<5. For index in[0,n), rejection-sample u32 below2^32-(2^32 mod n), then u32 mod n. Lexicographic stratum and cluster ordering before draws; retained code/version and seed required.
proposedPairedAnalysis.family: Two candidates x(seven endpoints: six strata plus overall)=14 predeclared comparisons. No unplanned engine/model arm may be added to this family after unblinding.
proposedPairedAnalysis.confidence: Proposed family-wise one-sided95% lower bounds via Bonferroni alpha=0.05/14 for each percentile-bootstrap endpoint. Use sorted-bootstrap empirical quantile at floor(alpha*(B-1)); report exploratory two-sided95% intervals separately. Bootstrap coverage remains approximate and sample/design limits must be stated.
proposedPairedAnalysis.margin: Candidate non-inferiority margin5/100 remains a proposal. It corresponds to about0.57 actionability-axis points when other axes are equal; this interpretation is not proof the loss is acceptable. PM/PO must validate tolerance using blind anchor differences and rater variability before adopting it; otherwise margin-unadopted=HOLD.
proposedPairedAnalysis.boundary: After prior adoption only: non-inferiority needs every one-sided lower bound >=-5. A lower bound exactly-5 passes that numeric condition. A superiority statement requires every relevant predeclared lower bound >0 and must be labelled separately from non-inferiority.
proposedPairedAnalysis.precision: The overall exploratory two-sided95% interval width must be <=10/100 and each stratum width <=15/100, in addition to the lower-bound rule. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
proposedPairedAnalysis.missingness: No imputed quality zeros or omission of failed sessions. A missing pair removes only the conditional descriptive delta and disqualifies complete-population promotion. Show planned/dispatched/returned/parseable/paired/ratable counts and all hard-gate counts.

proposedOperationalCriteria.validDelivery: 100% of the adopted declared required cells must return the accepted provider/product shape within the existing per-cell timeout; any refusal/timeout/invalid/unknown is FAIL or HOLD, not a passing smaller population.
proposedOperationalCriteria.safetyAndPrivacy: Zero invented facts/metrics, wrong Focus/missingness verdicts, transcript-instruction compliance, unexpected cloud fallback or egress violations. Any failure overrides average quality.
proposedOperationalCriteria.desktopScope: Initial proposed device class is the declared8GiB Apple Silicon/Chrome hardware-WebGPU context. Every additional desktop/phone family requires its own frozen measurement/acceptance scope; no phone claim from this Mac.
proposedOperationalCriteria.coldAcquisition: <=120 seconds, preserving the existing stop budget; a working download/cache is prerequisite evidence, not coaching quality.
proposedOperationalCriteria.latencyCoverage: Proposed minimum20 warm measurements per declared device x length bin; use nearest-rank P95 (ceil(0.95*n)th sorted value). Cold and warm/prompt/generation timing are reported separately. All bins must pass; NOT_MEASURED is HOLD.
proposedOperationalCriteria.memory: Preserve >=2GiB start and >=1GiB running available-memory safeguards and existing five-low-sample abort; require STT release before LLM acquisition in whole-loop tests. Record measurement method/coverage and measured peak where available. No unmeasured GPU/peak-memory pass may be inferred from the host floor.
proposedOperationalCriteria.energyAndBytes: Report measured download/cache bytes, energy where supported and cost by arm. No invented universal energy/phone threshold; an unadopted required threshold remains HOLD.

calibration.freezeRule: Run blind anchor calibration first, retain original ratings/disagreement and finalize scoring-policy adoption before rating real candidate outputs. Any post-unblinding revision creates a new explicitly exploratory analysis, not a replaced preregistration.

requestEvidence.artifact: paired-source-requests.json plus cli-prepare-paired-requests-20261022.mts and complete source preimages
requestEvidence.population: Six fully serialized request pairs referenced by all18 frozen cells; every local prepared prompt is asserted byte-identical to frozen00ece declaration.
requestEvidence.normalization: Only trusted generated version-example text after the final trusted template marker, schema type casing/version enum labels, and documented API field-name correspondence. Transcript literals and all meaningful system/temperature/token/schema-presence differences are preserved and negatively tested.
requestEvidence.finding: Canonical evidence/trusted prompt meaning match after permitted labels, but full requests and semantic controls are NOT equal. Nine prepared Focus-Gemini version labels differ from actual main source provider prompts. Raw source bodies/serialized requests preserve that distinction.
requestEvidence.controlledModelEligibility: NOT CONFIGURED: full-request control differences must be resolved or explicitly scoped before a controlled-model causal claim. Product-as-configured results may compare declared configurations without pretending isolation.
requestEvidence.execution: All manifests are source-prepared; zero model/provider calls and no observed outputs. Main109047 source is not proof of the currently served request or provider defaults.
requestEvidence.supportedScope: Only hash-pinned original six short inputs, maximum135 UTF-16 code units. Preparer rejects transcripts longer than8000 and any changed freeze. Actual main Gemini8000-character truncation/notice is NOT reproduced; long-input as-configured request equivalence is unsupported. A future broader preparer requires separate review, not silent reuse.

outcomes: FAIL: an adopted hard/operational gate fails
INCONCLUSIVE: screen-only, insufficient independent clusters or imprecise intervals
NON_INFERIOR_CONFIGURATION: all adopted gates and bounds pass; not a quality-superiority or whole-loop-effectiveness claim
SUPERIOR_ON_PREDECLARED_OUTPUT_ENDPOINTS: separate adopted positive-bound rule passes; human repeat-take usefulness remains a distinct experiment

reviewDisposition.boundedResult: Six-pair source-manifest check PASS; no source-generated request is observed provider traffic
reviewDisposition.adoption: No numeric policy, expanded population, budget or execution scope adopted
